svg.title: RedCommerce: delegated choice, commercial coverage, and illustrative adversarial interactions
svg.desc: Conceptual routes adapted from the supplied draw.io. Values are illustrative, not sampled experimental results. The lifecycle is corpus coverage, not a single executed seven-stage episode.

text.tspan: Maya delegates a headphone purchase. Agents must choose — but what permits the choice?
Mandate–Commitment Gap: choosing a suitable offer does not itself license its terms.
